summary: Pavonis Mons is a large shield volcano in the Tharsis region of Mars and the middle of three volcanoes known as the Tharsis Montes, which straddle the Martian equator. It was discovered by Mariner 9 in 1971, originally called Middle Spot, and renamed in 1973. Its equatorial location and height make it a frequently proposed site for a space elevator, especially in science fiction.
one_line: Pavonis Mons is a large shield volcano in Mars's Tharsis region, the middle of the Tharsis Montes chain.
key_facts: Pavonis Mons is Latin for "peacock mountain."
Pavonis Mons is a large shield volcano located in the Tharsis region of the planet Mars.
Pavonis Mons is the middle member of a chain of three volcanic mountains called the Tharsis Montes.
The Tharsis Montes straddle the Martian equator between longitudes 235°E and 259°E.
Pavonis Mons was discovered by the Mariner 9 spacecraft in 1971.
Pavonis Mons was originally called Middle Spot.
The name Pavonis Mons formally became official in 1973.
The equatorial location of the Pavonis Mons peak and its height make it an ideal terminus for a space elevator.
Pavonis Mons has often been proposed as a space elevator location, especially in science fiction.
